senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of בְּלוֹם, √בל, בלל , fodder-bag, nose-bag, muzzle) to muzzle, restrain.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 743:18">Yalk. Num. 743</cite> (read in place of <he>כדו בלום וכ׳</he>:) <he>פיו בָּלוּם לעמו של משה יכול הוא לִבְלוֹם צפורנו של אחד מהם</he> the mouth of the people of Moses is tied up (we dare not talk), but can he tie up (disable) the nail of any of them (the Canaanites)? <cite ref="Chullin 89a:9">Ḥull. 89ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="B00864"><he>בלימה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Job 26:7">Job XXVI, 7</cite>) <he>שבּוֹלֵם וכ׳</he> who restrains himself in strife (refrains from violence, keeps silence &c.).

senses.gloss: part. pass. בָּלוּם (cmp. אִלֵּם) unfit for use, lame, sore, swollen, closed by a tumor.
units: Bekh. 40ᵇ פיו ב׳ one whose mouth is swollen (one opin. in Rashi: shrunk); רגליו מְבוּלָּמוֹת (Pu.) one whose feet are swollen (shrunk). Ib. 43ᵇ חוטמו ב׳ Ar. (ed. בולם, corr. acc.) whose nose is obstructed.—
Gitt. 67ᵃ אוצר ב׳ a packed treasury of knowledge; v. בָּלַס.—Part. Pu. מְבוּלָּם, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to restrict … Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ bot. ובלבד שיַבְלִים לעיסתו provided that (when cutting &c.) he does only as much as is needed for his dough for the offering; [Tosaf. to Ḥag. 17ᵇ, s. v. אלא, cites שיכלה עיסתו, v. כָּלָה.]
